title: AW source-family onboarding contract
description: What a source family MUST declare before pipeline/assembly_binder.py will plan or stage it (task 529). The unit is the family: the set_id the claim manifests, the ADR-101 guards and payload_shape_contract.unit_of all already reason about, because that is the unit a producer owns. Every field here exists because an undeclared version of it shipped: the representation surfaces (task 526/527 -- the rebuild changed WHAT TEXT is embedded in at least two families without a ruling), the chunk policy id (only 2 of 86 sealed families declare one), the consent terminal schema version (task 502 defect 1 / task 521: 28,477 points sealed as `declined` under a v5 reading of `robots_unreadable`), the licence instrument (never inferred from hosting -- 2026-08-20), the title shape (task 516: fedlex, 22,913 of 22,928 rows), the point-id minting rule (ADR-101 Ruling 2: the sealed id wins, the binder does not re-mint), the ADR-039 payload minimum, the gate classes the family must not regress, and the guards that apply. A declaration is the family's own statement of intent; the validator checks it against the ratified ADRs and the artifacts on disk, and refuses when they disagree. It never derives the declaration from the evidence -- a declaration derived from what it reports is a tautology (assembly_guards.py, 'The plan is not derived from the ledger').

ratified_by.description: The PR whose merge by Tim ratified this document. Contract schemas are legislative (memory: legislative-prs) -- never self-merged.

roster_source.description: Where the family roster comes from. Derived from a manifest, never a hand-list (memory: census-roster-from-manifest -- three blind spots in one week, 2026-08-28).

unknown.description: The sentinel for a value the sealed evidence does not carry. Never a guess: a guessed value is worse than an absent one because it reads as measured. Every path holding this sentinel MUST also appear in the family's `unknowns` list, and a family with a non-empty `unknowns` cannot have status `declared`.

evidence.description: The paths actually read to fill this block. `Only artifacts are evidence` (verification-doctrine 5).

family_id.description: The set_id. Must be a key of the roster source, and must be the id the binder stages by.

canonical_id.description: Optional real name by alias (RULING 78, task 2855). Unique across rows; never another row's family_id or legacy id; never task/scratch-named. Sealed data stays keyed by family_id.

legacy_ids.description: Required when canonical_id is set; must contain this row's own family_id.

status.description: `declared` = a complete declaration, zero unknowns; the only status a NEW family may carry. `backfilled` = reconstructed from sealed evidence for a family that shipped before this contract existed, and is allowed to carry unknowns -- the grandfathering is DATA, ratified by Tim's merge, not a waiver granted in code (memory: gate-waivers-escalate-to-tim). `retired` = no longer contributes vectors.

population.description: The set_id in data/assembly/sealed-populations.v1.json whose shard triplet carries this family's vectors. For a family pooled into `task417_families`, that pool id.

route.description: How the bytes were obtained. `bulk-direct` = direct fetch of the publisher's own bulk files (POLICY v3.2, ruling 25.2 and ruling 26 item 20a); the licence or statute, not a robots probe of the host, is the consent instrument. `unknown` is legal only for a backfilled family.

representation.description: WHAT TEXT is embedded and WHAT TEXT is posted. The embedding surface is a contract: task 526/527 found the rebuild had silently changed it for fedlex (anchor-scaffolded article body, no law name/abbreviation/SR) and for entity cards (a 1,600-char website blurb, officers truncated, NO sparse surface at all), and full-stack scoring masked both because BM25 carried the query. Task 527 owns the per-family reconstruction and the prov_id pin; this block is where its result lands.

dense_surface.description: The composition of the text handed to the embedder, stated so a reader can reproduce it (e.g. 'title + \"\\n\\n\" + chunk body, chunk body verbatim from the sealed materializer').

sparse_surface.description: The composition of the BM25 surface. The literal string `none` is a legal value ONLY with a `ruling` that names the ADR or task that ruled it -- an absent sparse surface is exactly the entity-card defect.

prov_id.description: The provenance id that pins this pair of surfaces, so a later build can be proven to embed the same thing.

ruling.description: IDENTICAL = provably the same surfaces as the incumbent. RULED = different, and a named ruling authorises the difference. UNRULED = different with no ruling -- the task-526/527 defect class; a family may not FLIP while UNRULED.

chunk_policy.description: Which chunk policy produced the rows, pinned by digest. Key names mirror `text_recipe.chunk_policy` in the claim manifests rather than forking a second vocabulary (engineering-doctrine 1).

policy_family.description: Which chunker family the policy serves: a key of `policy_families` in data/chunk-policy-registry.v1.json (chunk.generic / chunk.law / chunk.news / chunk.reference / chunk.atomic / chunk.preserved). ADR-090 §3/§4 split `chunk` into chunk.generic and chunk.law and scoped 'standardize on 1152' to the generic path alone; specs/epochs.md §5 says a third family is split FORMALLY, not absorbed. Before that registry existed this had no machine-readable home at all, which is why task 535's 3.73x granularity change across 82 hosts was invisible to every check in the repo. NOT the same axis as chunk_provenance.FAMILIES, which names the PRODUCER (generic-structured, law-article-117, ...) rather than the boundary rule set; a chunk.reference row is produced by `generic-structured` exactly like a chunk.generic row. Checked against the registry by pipeline/source_family_contract._check_chunk_policy_registry.

consent.description: ADR-024 / ADR-073 / ADR-092 / ADR-103. Consent is re-resolved live per source and never inherited from Common Crawl (CLAUDE.md constraint). The terminal schema version is load-bearing: task 521 measured 28,477 of 129,120 lost points sealed as `declined` when 18 of the 20 hosts were admissible -- the rollout ran at terminal v5, before v6 split `robots_unreadable` out of `declined`.

basis.description: e.g. 'robots.txt live per origin', 'API terms of service', 'bulk-dump licence + robots'.

resolution.description: `inherited-from-common-crawl` is deliberately absent from this enum: it is prohibited, and an enum that cannot express it cannot ship it.

licence.description: The instrument, never the host. 'Never infer a legal basis from where a document is hosted; consent and licence are independent gates' (memory: licence-basis-from-the-instrument, 2026-08-20).

instrument.description: The named licence, statute, or terms document. `unknown` is an ADR-039 licensing EXCEPTION -- counted, never hidden (pipeline/aw_b1_license.py).

basis.description: `hosting` is deliberately absent: inferring a licence from the host is the prohibited move.

inferred_from_hosting.description: There is exactly one legal value. The field exists so the prohibition is asserted per family rather than remembered.

title_shape.description: payload_shape_contract's title contract, per family. Deliberately opt-in: task 516 measured five families whose production titles never carried a pattern, and inventing one would fail a build over a rule nobody needed. Opting out therefore requires a `why`.

why.description: Carried verbatim from data/payload-shape-contract.v1.json, which writes a multi-line rationale as an array of lines. Both shapes are legal so the two files never have to be reformatted to agree.

identity.description: How a point id is minted, and by whom. ADR-101 Ruling 2: the sealed point id wins and the binder does not re-mint -- re-minting produces a different identity space and invalidates the whole guard chain.

rebinds_at_assembly.description: ADR-101 Ruling 2. One legal value, asserted per family.

payload_minimum.description: ADR-039. The compact redistributable dump carries per-record `license`; owner/attribution and license_version are master-only and stripped from the dump.

gate_classes.description: The eval classes this family serves and must therefore not regress. Drawn from the ratified 629-query instrument's class taxonomy.

guards.description: The ADR-101 guards that must evaluate this family. A replacement owes G1 (point-level claims), G3 (one disposition per membership point), G5 (rows whose bound old points all lost are never loaded) and G7 (distinct loaded ids, replaced ids upserted not deleted) -- assembly_guards.py states that burden itself.

contracts.description: The pipeline contracts that must evaluate this family at stage/verify.

unknowns.description: Every dotted path in this declaration whose value is the `unknown` sentinel. The validator recomputes this set and refuses when the list disagrees -- a family cannot hide an unknown by omitting it, and cannot inflate one to look thorough.

producer_ids.description: Optional. Producer labels this family's rows carry (a frozen string written into served rows or sealed receipts), keyed by the string itself. The string never changes; the entry records its meaning and where the code that writes it lives (task 1316 / D6).
